A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MammAlps and the same two benchmarks. The complete main text and supplementary Sections 7–10, including equations, figures and tables, support reliable comparison despite added tables and repagination.

before.justification: V1 reports original model evaluations on both MammAlps benchmarks, including baseline comparisons, modality experiments, ablations and per-class results.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and reports additional training replicates, updated benchmark results and variability estimates.

M1.justification: The multimodal VideoMAE adaptation, classification heads, losses, offline token-merging algorithm and positional embeddings remain unchanged. Correcting audio–video alignment repairs the data rather than introducing a method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MammAlps coverage: 6,135 clips for B1 and 397 events for B2, with the same species, behavior categories, modalities and prediction tasks. No dataset, population or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: Table 8 retains SlowFast-8x8, X3D-M, mViT-v2 and the same VideoMAE variants. The modality combinations and single-versus-joint prediction comparators also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The new revision note reports correcting a few audio files that were misaligned with their corresponding videos, changing the data preparation underlying B1. Splits, metrics, sampling procedures, model configurations and per-run training budgets otherwise remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The ablation questions and controls remain the same: modality combinations, token reduction, positional embeddings and camera views. Table 6, the camera-view ablation (v1 Table 13; v2 Table 14) and per-class analyses are retained. Updated scores and replication statistics introduce no additional ablation or robustness design.

E5.justification: V1 reports point estimates without seed counts or standard deviations. V2 explicitly reports additional replicates and three-seed means for Table 4 and the joint-task rows of Table 5, adding overall standard deviations there and task-level standard deviations in new supplementary Tables 9 and 15. This substantially expands uncertainty reporting across both principal benchmarks.

E6.justification: Central estimates are revised: Table 4's V+A+S overall mAP changes from 0.438 to 0.466, while Table 5's r=14 and r=11 averages change from 0.476/0.498 to 0.489/0.500. Some task-level rankings change, but V+A and r=11 remain the respective overall leaders. These are updated estimates following correction and replication, not evidence of an improved algorithm.

T1.justification: The tracking-cost definition in Equation 1, task definitions and offline token-merging formulation in Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises theoretical results, assumptions or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and novelty claims: the MammAlps dataset, hierarchical multimodal recognition, and multi-view long-term event understanding with an offline token-condensation baseline.

C2.justification: V2 newly acknowledges the audio-alignment defect and characterizes its correction as having little or no performance impact in the revision note. The existing interpretations of modality contributions, token-merging limitations and ecological applicability remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Table 1 changes the dataset DOI from 10.5281/zenodo.15040901 to 10.5281/zenodo.15040900, and the revision note states that the released data include the alignment correction. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and the code-access link otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 57 cited works and substantive related-work discussion are retained. Changes to citation page references reflect repagination rather than altered research positioning.

P1.justification: V2 adds a short revision note and an explanation of repeated-run reporting, renames Section 9.2 to include variability, and adjusts captions and cross-references. The main narrative and section sequence remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 4 and 5 gain standard-deviation formatting and revised captions, and supplementary Tables 9 and 15 are added. Existing appendix tables are relocated or renumbered, with local reflow and a nearly empty page 17. The eight figures retain their substantive visual content.

improvement.justification: The reported audio-alignment repair improves data integrity, while additional runs and standard deviations make the principal benchmark estimates more informative and transparent. The benefit is limited by a reporting ambiguity: per-class appendix tables retain v1 estimates without clearly explaining their relationship to the updated averages. Overall, the correction and stronger uncertainty reporting provide a modest net improvement.
